context.body: The narrator closes the complete discourse and returns attention to the crowds.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Matthew reports that Jesus finishes the sayings and the crowds are astonished.
observations.label: The crowds respond to Jesus’ authority: action

observations.body: They distinguish his teaching authority from that of their scribes.
observations.label: The crowds respond to Jesus’ authority: response

payload.posture: Read Matthew 7:28–29 as judgment, discernment, and doing evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage reports astonishment but does not say that all hearers become doers.
payload.title: The crowds respond to Jesus’ authority
